name: ANSI/IEEE pressure switch nc symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for pressure switch nc, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The pressure-operated NC form describes an initially continuous path changed by a documented pressure action. Its setting and process connection give meaning to the electrical circuit, while the contact rating remains a separate product property.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace both the pressure condition and controlled circuit destination.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An NC pressure switch produces a discrete state rather than a continuous pressure measurement signal.
